Fiido Cycle to Work Scheme: How to save money and enhance your commute. **The UK Cycle to Work Scheme is a government-supported benefit program designed to encourage employees to commute by bicycle instead of driving or using public transport. Through this scheme, employees can purchase bicycles, including electric bicycle, and related accessories via salary sacrifice, enjoying significant tax savings that lower the cost of buying a bike. This means employees save on income tax and National Insurance, which results in a lower overall cost for the bike. 1.     **Save Money** The Cycle to Work Scheme offers incredible discounts, saving you up to 48.25% on electric bike costs. Saving enough money to buy a home may seem impossible, but there are things you can do right now to prepare. One of the most crucial things to do when trying to save money to buy a home is to set a savings target. Expenses to anticipate include the down payment (typically between 3% and 20% of the home's purchase price), closing costs on the mortgage loan (typically about 2-5% of the loan amount), inspection costs (usually $500-$1500), and moving costs. This will help you understand how much money to save to buy a house in the future. Once you have a realistic home price in mind, you can work backward by setting a realistic savings budget. "Some habits that people can change to save a bit more money is to eat out less or only buy what is necessary," Bolstad advises. Paying off loans will free up money that can be redirected to your home savings. Some people can leverage tax-advantaged retirement accounts, like the 401(k), TSP, and IRA, that can be tapped for home loans or personal loans (for a down payment).
